title: Document type is not ESTABLISHMENT REGISTRATION
fix: Set the document <code> to code="51725-0" (LOINC ESTABLISHMENT REGISTRATION).

title: Document code is not declared as LOINC
Document id or setId is not a distinct UUID
fix: Give <id> a fresh UUID for this version and keep <setId> the stable UUID of the registration; they must never be equal.

title: versionNumber is missing or not a positive integer
fix: Set <versionNumber value="1"/> on a first submission and raise it by one on every resubmission.

title: effectiveTime is not a valid YYYYMMDD date
fix: Write effectiveTime as eight digits, for example value="20261001".

title: effectiveTime falls outside the October 1 - December 31 registration window
fix: Date the annual registration inside the October 1 - December 31 window of the year you are registering for.

title: Registration is for an earlier year and has already lapsed
fix: Re-date and resubmit the registration inside this year's October 1 - December 31 window.

title: No D-U-N-S number is carried on any organization
fix: Add <id extension="123456789" root="1.3.6.1.4.1.519.1"/> to the registrant and to every establishment.

title: D-U-N-S number is not exactly nine digits
fix: Write the D-U-N-S number as nine digits with no dashes, spaces or leading letters.
